entries.title: II Chronicles 3:1
segments:
Mount Moriah; an elevation in the eastern part of Jerusalem. 
 
However great or difficult the work to which God calls men, in his name and strength they should undertake it, with confidence that he will give them all needed aid.

entries.title: II Chronicles 3:3
segments: To those who are disposed to learn and do their whole duty, God will grant all needful instruction; so that they will see not only what to do, but also how to do it in order to meet his approbation, secure his blessing, and be made benefactors to mankind.

entries.title: II Chronicles 3:6
segments: Parvaim; perhaps a general name for the eastern regions whence the gold came.

entries.title: II Chronicles 3:14
segments: The veil; between the holy and the most holy place.

entries.title: II Chronicles 3:15
segments:
